text:
Anya: Quick heads-up — we're running a prelaunch throttle simulation tomorrow 09:00 PST. Goal: 2.5x traffic for ~90m to validate fallbacks, region routing, KV-cache behavior, and network limits. Please ack and drop any runbook notes or constraints. :rocket:

Sam: Ack. I'll join. What pool do we target? dedicated or burst spot?

Kevin: Recommend primary in us-west2, overflow to eu-west1. Use quantized variants for overflow to save cost.

Maria: Noted. Also watching for kernel stalls — last sim we had 3 host OOMs when batch sizes spiked.

Jin: I'll stage int8 profiles for the 13b/7b splits and a smaller 3b fallback. Will push artifacts to staging by EOD.

Anya: Cost estimate — baseline avg is ~120 GPUs. 2.5x => ~300 GPUs. Extra = 180 GPUs * 1.5h = 270 GPU-hours. Add warmup + safety => ~320 GPU-hours. Tag finance if this looks off. ```calc
baseline=120
mult=2.5
target=baseline*mult # 300
extra=target-baseline # 180
gpu_hours=extra*1.5 # 270
``` 

Nora: Marketing might flip the switch at 10:00 PST. Can we ensure fallback routes to smaller models if latency climbs > 500ms 95th?

Sam: Add a canary that shifts new sessions to dedicated for first 3 minutes, then to shared. Also add alert: `p95_latency > 500ms` and `error_rate > 1%`.

Maria: Runbook note — last time we hit NAT egress quotas in eu-west1. Add a precheck: `gcloud compute addresses list` and throw a warning if free < 10.

Kevin: I can spin up a spot pool as buffer but watch preemption. Suggest setting `min_ready=80%` on rollout so we don't kill existing capacity.

Jin: Reminder to lower KV cache save interval and set `cache_hit_threshold=0.6` for the sim so we can observe degradation.

Anya: Ops checklist:
- Dashboards live: p95/p99 latency, GPU utilization, host OOMs, network egress
- Alerts: GPU mem > 92%, CPU steal > 10%, node_restarts > 1/min
- Fallbacks: 13b->7b->3b then compact quantized variant
- Routing: us-west2 primary, eu-west1 overflow

Sam: I'll add the ephemeral alert and post the PagerDuty escalation plan in #eng-oncall. Also will run the capacity calc script and paste numbers.

deploy-bot: Simulation window scheduled: 1765515600. Reminder will be posted 30m before.

Anya: Perfect. If no major concerns, we'll run the sim and reconvene +30m post-sim to review hot spots. :thumbsup:
